reviews.title: This app is so bad
reviews.text: Have they not ever updated this

reviews.title: Nagging for money
reviews.text:
This was a great program years ago. Gave you the ability to match up your ingredients to possible results.

Apparently that wasn't good enough, now it is nothing but another app looking for continuous revenue without anything in return other than NOT wasting your time and probably selling your data to others. 

It is a database. There's no need for any of this other nonsense, the app was ruined.
